Install omarchy-meeting-recorder on Omarchy

Meeting Recorder for Omarchy: record the mic and the computer audio, transcribed on your own machine with speakers, chapters and a player

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add omarchy-meeting-recorder-bin
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 1.8.0-1:
    pacman -Qi omarchy-meeting-recorder-bin

Open and use omarchy-meeting-recorder

To see what the package installed, including any commands and desktop entries:

pacman -Ql omarchy-meeting-recorder-bin

Frequently asked questions

How do I install omarchy-meeting-recorder on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add omarchy-meeting-recorder-bin. The download is 17.2 MB and it takes 67.1 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is omarchy-meeting-recorder free?

Check the project site for current pricing. The package is licensed MIT.

How do I uninstall omarchy-meeting-recorder?

Run omarchy pkg drop omarchy-meeting-recorder-bin. It removes the package from your system.

What does omarchy-meeting-recorder depend on?

The package declares 11 dependencies: gtk4, libadwaita, glib2, pango, cairo, graphene, libgcc, libstdc++, glibc, libpulse, ffmpeg. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is omarchy-meeting-recorder in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as omarchy-meeting-recorder-bin (version 1.8.0-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. jankeesvw makes it.
